description: Canadian social insurance numbers: 9 digits that pass the Luhn check, written as digits (grouped 3-3-3 or not at all) or spoken as digit words in English or French. Each case lists the exact substrings a redactor must find, in order. Every number is made up; numbers starting with 0 are never issued.

cases.text: zero four six four five four two eight six
found: zero four six four five four two eight six

cases.text: oh one two, three four five, six seven four
found: oh one two, three four five, six seven four

cases.text: mon NAS est zéro quatre six, quatre cinq quatre, deux huit six
found: zéro quatre six, quatre cinq quatre, deux huit six
